description: The bar chart titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks" compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (orange bars)—across nine different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the datasets and metrics: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents the score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 80 with tick marks at intervals of 10%. On GSM-8K, both models achieve high scores, with LLaMA-3-8B-it at approximately 80% and Ours slightly higher at around 82%. On MMLU, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores about 70%, while Ours reaches 65%. In HumanEval, Ours significantly outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it, with scores of 70% and 60%, respectively. For TruthfulQA, Ours achieves 65% compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it’s 45%. On ARC and MBPP, both models perform identically at 60%. In LC AlpacaEval-2 and MT-Bench (×5), Ours shows a slight edge, with scores of approximately 35% and 45%, respectively, compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it’s 25% and 40%. On the most challenging benchmark, Chat-Arena-Hard, both models score below 30%, with Ours at around 30% and LLaMA-3-8B-it at approximately 22%. Overall, Ours (Iterative RLHF) demonstrates superior performance across most benchmarks, particularly in HumanEval and TruthfulQA, indicating stronger generalization capabilities.
